name: Soundwave Art
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: The waveform of any sound as a poster: pick a track or a video from the media library (the wedding song, the first dance from the wedding film, a podcast episode), or record your own voice right in the studio - a message, a laugh, a heartbeat on the phone. The studio opens on an example sound, so there is always a wave to start from. Style it as bars, line, filled, dots, pulse, LED, circle, ridgeline (the record-sleeve mountain lines), spiral (the whole song wound into one image), sunburst rings, or the heartbeat running around a heart or hexagon contour - or draw it from its frequencies: a spectrogram, the song as an image of what sounds when, and a sound mandala that grows the song in rings from the centre, every beat a ring. Color it solid, with curated gradients including gold, copper and chrome foils, or let the SOUND pick the colors (bassy parts dark, trebly parts bright). Add neon glow, a mirror reflection, or split left and right channel into two colors. Insert as a classic poster with title, subtitle and duration, or as a music player card with progress bar and timestamps - all as editable layers. Export it as a video that moves with the music, including a feed format for social posts, made frame by frame as an MP4 with its sound. The audio is analyzed locally in the browser. Reopen any wave via Edit Soundwave Art.
